args.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create exactly ONE faithful edited product photograph of IMAGE1. IMAGE1 is the sole target; IMAGE2 is ONLY the approved Full Muscle paint color reference, and IMAGE3 is ONLY the italic Full Muscle EQUIPMENT logo reference. Do not borrow machinery or the camera from reference images. Preserve the target's exact model, geometry, number and positions of components, proportions, white background, original camera, framing, padding, handles, safety instructions and mechanical details. Apply satin forest green around #356B35 with realistic existing light and shadow only to the specified painted steel parts. All pads/grips stay black, metallic guide rods/pins/bolts/plate sleeves remain metallic, pulleys/cables stay unchanged. Replace supplier brand logos with the italic 'Full Muscle' wordmark, Full white and Muscle green, with small white 'EQUIPMENT' beneath; keep the logo small and physically printed on the same surface, in correct perspective. If a rear stack panel has a vertical brand, replace it with Full Muscle rotated CLOCKWISE90, Full at TOP, Muscle below, behind foreground rods/weights. Never remove exercise or safety labels. If no supplier logo exists, put one modest Full Muscle wordmark on a suitable upper crossbar or main support. No other text added, no external labels, no background design. Keep the full machine and original image aspect ratio. Render sharply, no redesign.
Specific edit for FM-GC-5026: This Roman chair has two separate large hip pads and two ankle rollers. Recolor ONLY the existing angled rectangular steel support tube directly beneath the pair of hip pads forest green, including short pad mounting brackets. Keep the notched angle-adjustment sector black, upright rear support and base legs black, all black pads/ankle rollers and handgrips unchanged, foot plates black and pivot caps silver. Replace supplier logo on center vertical support with Full Muscle in same orientation.

review: Visually reviewed: machine type, main geometry, pad shape, green placement, branding, white background. Marketing illustration; fine microtext is not technical documentation.
